tasks.decision: W falls within P's declared design scope. Require the adopted obligations whose additional applicability predicates hold. Service B is outside this adoption; unresolved later boundary relations do not establish exclusion.
tasks.justification: Method availability, Product adoption and actor activation are separate relations. The Product-owned durable basis governs the shared frame configuration; an authorized work instruction activates an exact evaluation. Partial adoption narrows its declared scope without waiving other applicable constraints.

representation.statement: Proposed bounded contract ScopeAndActivation(P, work, subject, basis, actor); not a full native a_c program or an actual activation grant.
premises: The selected method cut makes the software-design and engagement-baseline profiles available.
P has adopted the design discipline for service A, explicitly naming its boundary and rule family. Service B is outside that declaration. W changes A.

A concrete activation cites P's accepted Project Reference-Frame Basis, its admitting authorities, governed scope, frame declarations, evaluation inventory, grants, capability envelopes, result relations and invalidation conditions.
applicability: W is within the declared design boundary. For each conditional obligation in the adopted rule family, evaluate its owning applicability predicate against sufficient facts bound to the exact subject and basis.
For B, the declaration supports exclusion of obligations introduced solely by this scoped adoption. It does not establish exclusion from independently applicable constraints.

For a later work item whose boundary relation cannot be established, applicability remains unresolved. Keep the potentially required obligation in dependent coverage until evidence or the owning decision resolves it.
Availability of the engagement-baseline profile does not establish that P adopted its Executive, Worker and Reviewer configuration.
obligations: Keep the durable Product-owned basis distinct from the execution-scoped activation. A ticket or other authorized work instruction binds the actor to an applicable frame or configuration, exact evaluation, subject, basis, evidence boundary and capability envelope.
Activate only within the cited grants. Actor names, frame names, available tools and listed evaluation families confer no additional authority.
A true applicability predicate requires the applicable evaluation and its result. Check that a required result is current, applicable to the subject and basis, and capable of establishing its claim.
Preserve other applicable common constraints even when adoption is partial or only one evaluation detects a constraint.
exceptions: Partial design adoption is permitted when its boundary and rule family are explicit; it cannot support a completion claim that skips evidence needed to audit, refactor or reconstruct the realised boundary.
A supported false applicability predicate excludes only the corresponding obligation under its cited authority. The excluded evaluation is not performed and receives no core result.
The Product may adopt an available profile or define a project configuration. Profile availability alone selects neither.
result_mapping: Applicability predicate true -> satisfied; require the obligation's separate evaluation.
Applicability predicate false on supported facts -> falsified for applicability; record authorized exclusion, not satisfaction or falsification of the excluded obligation itself.
Missing or ambiguous applicability premise -> indeterminate; an undeclared required relation may ground out_of_frame. Neither means inapplicable.
The obligation's performed evaluation returns its own predicate-relative core result. Availability, applicability, evaluation satisfaction and acceptance cannot substitute for one another.
residuals: Retain the exact unresolved boundary relation, needed evidence or owning decision, and any semantic judgment used to establish applicability.
This contract supplies no Product acceptance, permanent actor assignment or authority beyond an exact authorized activation.

tasks.decision: Define a predicate-preserving handoff and conjunction contract. Availability, fitness and owner acceptance remain separate assessed questions; gaps, counterexamples and uncertain effects survive combination.
tasks.justification: The core algebra governs performed evaluations. Non-performance supplies no result. Conjunction separately carries applicable returns, planned assessments lacking applicable returns, and uncovered obligations. Its declared rule determines permitted choices among non-satisfied returns without erasing failures or gaps.

representation.statement: Proposed contract Handoff(X, B, predicates, required_coverage, mandatory_results, conjunction_rule). It specifies admissible handoffs and combination, not that any particular X satisfies them.
premises: Declare three distinct predicates: X is available; X meets its declared criteria; the mandate-bound decision owner accepted X at the specified boundary.
Each contributing evaluation identifies its exact predicate, subject, basis, evaluator authority and admitted coverage.
For a composite claiming all three questions hold, all three are mandatory. A narrower composite must explicitly declare its different predicate and required coverage.
applicability: A returned result contributes only to the predicate and subject/basis relation it establishes.
Results on different bases combine only through declared relations supporting a coherent composite basis.
Required coverage remains required until an authorized applicability determination excludes it; a missing assessment is not an exclusion.
obligations: For every performed evaluation, return the core value together with its predicate, original domain outcome, exact subject and basis, evidence, findings and bounded corrections where relevant, residual uncertainty and invalidation conditions.
Preserve domain outcomes through every join. A core mapping does not replace or own their domain meaning.
Maintain three separate inputs: applicable closed returns; planned required assessments without an applicable closed return; required obligations outside the admitted coverage of planned assessments.
Place an unperformed required evaluation, absent return, or held stale/wrong-subject/wrong-basis return in the planned-assessment gap input. Retain any historical result with its original basis.
Distinguish an evaluation actually performed on an unsuitable basis, which returns invalid_basis or is reactivated, from a composite merely holding an old result, which has an applicable-return gap.
Carry every known counterexample, planned-assessment gap and uncovered obligation through joins. Agreement cannot erase them.
Preserve possible effects with unobserved completion as uncertain effects. Do not map them to completed effects or no effect.
exceptions: The consumer declares mandatory results, required coverage, conflict and indeterminacy handling, basis compatibility, decision authority, treatment of non-mandatory results, and veto or deferral rules.

There is no universal ordering among non-satisfied core values. Where several mandatory non-satisfied returns exist, the declared rule chooses among those returns while retaining their evidence and all gaps.
A reviewer may recommend a disposition. That recommendation is evidence for the decision owner and does not apply a disposition or authorize continuation.
result_mapping: Performed evaluation: satisfied means its declared predicate holds on the exact basis; falsified means a declared counterexample defeats it; indeterminate means admissible evidence cannot decide; out_of_frame means a required relation or capability is undeclared; invalid_basis means the subject or basis cannot support evaluation.
Unperformed evaluation -> no core value. Do not label the component indeterminate or falsified.

All mandatory results satisfied with valid applicable evidence, coherent declared basis relations, no gaps and no material counterexample -> satisfied for the composite when these exhaust its declared contract.

A mandatory non-satisfied return -> a non-satisfied value selected from the returns under the declared rule. If the only such return is a witnessed falsification, report falsified even alongside a missing required assessment; preserve the missing assessment separately.
All mandatory returned results satisfied, but declared relations among their required bases disagree -> invalid_basis; retain any gaps.

All mandatory returned results satisfied and basis relations agree, but a planned-assessment or coverage gap remains -> indeterminate for the composite. This does not assign indeterminate to an unperformed component.
A material counterexample to a mandatory constraint prevents success regardless of which contributor found it. Non-mandatory falsifications remain recorded with their predicates.
A satisfied availability result establishes neither fitness nor acceptance. Assessing an existing acceptance decision does not make that decision.
residuals: Name gaps by kind and item: planned assessment without an applicable return, uncovered obligation, or both.
Keep undecided claims, uncertain effects, failures and basis defects distinct, with the evidence, relation, capability or repair needed to resolve each.
No semantic authority transfers through conjunction.

tasks.decision: Reuse A through its stipulated preservation relation; do not reuse B or C's old passes as current assurance. G remains mandatory. Reject the 99% Product-correctness claim. Followups: P satisfied; F falsified with C's gap preserved; U indeterminate.
tasks.justification: A has supported preservation covering assertion, execution and reliance dependencies. B executes the changed library. C's incomplete dependency coverage cannot establish preservation from an absent path. Independent mandatory applicability keeps G required. Shared expected-output generation and observations do not establish independent assurance, and passing limited predicates does not establish Product correctness.

representation.statement: Bounded assessment of assurance for S1/B1, preserving the stipulated facts and separating the initial state from followups P, F and U.
premises: A, B and C passed on S0/B0. L changes, producing S1/B1.
A's applicable preservation relation is established with supported coverage of its assertion, execution and reliance dependencies; those dependencies are unaffected.
B executes L. C's dependency view lacks a path from L but has incomplete material dependency coverage.
G applies independently of change-based selection.
The two suites share an implementation-derived expected-output generator and old input observations despite different authoring model families.
applicability: A may contribute for its preserved predicate through the established relation to S1/B1. Retain S0/B0 provenance and the preservation justification; do not merely relabel the old pass.
B's old pass has no established preservation to the changed execution dependency. Obtain current applicable evidence.
C's applicability for reuse is unresolved. An absent path in an incomplete dependency view does not establish unaffectedness.
G cannot be excluded by change-based selection because its mandatory applicability is independently stipulated.
obligations: Acquire current B evidence and either sufficient preservation support or current evaluation evidence for C. Execute and obtain G's applicable result.
Compose the fixed required obligations and material joins on a coherent current basis; retain missing applicable returns as gaps.
For assurance oracles, derive governing expectations from Product, requirement and accepted-design law. Account for shared failure sources before claiming independence.
A numerical Product-correctness claim would require support for its exact probabilistic claim and scope. Nominal miss-rate multiplication alone supplies none.
exceptions: A need not be repeated solely because L changed: its preservation is a supplied fact.
Different authoring model families do not by themselves establish independent errors, independent observations or independent semantic oracles.
The arithmetic 0.1 × 0.1 = 0.01 establishes neither the joint miss probability nor a 99% probability that the Product is correct.
result_mapping: Initial state: A is reusable within its preserved claim. B needs current evidence; C reuse is unresolved; G may not be skipped. Required assurance completion is not established.

P: satisfied for 'the required assurance for this change is complete'. Current B/C passes, G's pass, established A applicability, and valid support for every fixed required obligation and material join close the bounded contract. Do not invent further missing obligations.

F: falsified for the bounded completion claim because B provides an admissible counterexample to a required predicate. C's missing current return remains a separate planned-assessment gap. The gap neither erases the counterexample nor becomes a fabricated C result.

U: indeterminate for the bounded completion claim. B and G pass and no counterexample is supplied, but C's dispatch receipt supplies no applicable closed return. Do not infer either C's success or its failure.
None of these results is Product acceptance. P establishes the bounded assurance claim, not general Product correctness or the manager's numerical claim.
residuals: Initial state: obtain B/C's needed current support and G's return.
F: retain B's counterexample and its correction/re-evaluation pressure, plus C's missing return.
U: obtain C's valid current return or perform the needed current evaluation; dispatch alone does not discharge it.

tasks.decision: Refuse the present design-method completion declaration: two applicable publication requirements are unmet. P satisfies the bounded gate. U leaves applicability unresolved and cannot support completion.
tasks.justification: The owning design law requires the reference-to-target derivation asset for a materially changed boundary derived from an existing realisation, and a module-derived unit test lane for an active implementation. Both conditions hold in the present case. The supplied Ontology, IACS and three-view evidence do not discharge those separate requirements.

representation.statement: Bounded design-gate assessment for W on service A; the present case, P and U are separate branches.
premises: The present adoption covers A and its active implementation. W materially changes A's typed schema and derives from an existing realisation.

The accepted Ontology is complete for this change, including admitted atom domains and projection traceability; IACS derivation and reconciliation are complete; Ontology-derived domain, sequence and state assets are published.
The reference-to-target derivation asset is unpublished. Helper-level tests exist, but no module-derived unit test lane is published.
All other applicable criteria for this bounded gate have adequate current evidence.
applicability: Present case: derivation from an existing realisation activates the reference-to-target publication requirement; active implementation activates the module-derived unit test lane requirement.
P preserves the present applicability and supplies the missing current publications with their criteria established.
U replaces established current adoption applicability with an old-boundary record whose relation to the changed service is unresolved. Do not import P's positive evidence into this separate variant.
obligations: Publish the reference-to-target derivation asset before claiming design-method completion for the changed boundary.
Publish the module-derived unit test lane before claiming closure for the materially changed active implementation.
Judge completion against the owning specification. Silence in a bounded representation cannot exclude an obligation stated by its owner.
exceptions: Partial adoption may narrow its declared scope, but it cannot justify skipping evidence needed to audit, refactor or reconstruct the realised adopted boundary.
Helper-level tests do not discharge the specifically absent publication. They may be evidence within a justified lane, but the scenario states that no such lane is published.
Do not invent additional Ontology, IACS, projection or other gate defects: their adequacy is stipulated.
result_mapping: Present: falsified for the bounded design-completion/closure predicate. Two applicable required publications are absent.
P: satisfied for the bounded gate. Both missing publications and their criteria are established on the current basis, while every other applicable criterion already has adequate evidence.

U: indeterminate for whether the design obligations apply to this changed service; consequently withhold the dependent completion claim. Keep potentially applicable obligations in required coverage. The publication absences remain facts, but unresolved applicability does not establish either exclusion or failure of an applicable gate.

For U, a completion evaluation actually grounded in a mismatched old boundary cannot use that as a valid current basis; such an evaluation has invalid_basis. This is distinct from the indeterminate applicability predicate.
Present failure blocks this completion declaration. P establishes only the bounded gate. U establishes no completion. None supplies Product acceptance or release authorization.
residuals: Present: publish and establish the two missing items on the relevant basis.
P: no unresolved criterion remains within the stipulated bounded gate.
U: obtain evidence or the owning authority's resolution establishing the adoption record's relation to the changed service, then assess the obligations under that resolved scope.

limitations: Scope is the frozen claude candidate at checkpoint b7e8f73d6b9908ecb0f6cc1609aa99ed94ce81f7. Its authored interpretation is proposed and partial: 155 clauses, five frame indexes, 24 sections encoded in part and 182 sections not encoded. No encoded residuals does not mean no unresolved questions.

These are small semantic contracts and bounded applications of the cited owning text. They are not a complete native a_c program, exhaustive methodology interpretation, complete regression plan or calibrated reliability model.

The hypothetical facts are treated as stipulated. Positive branches establish their stated bounded predicates; neither those findings nor the proposed representations confer Product acceptance or mutation authority.
